item.description:
Theme Squeeze for Brunch 0.1.0

  • Adds a Brunch edition with its own app identity, navy-and-paper branding, installer, local workspace, and signed update feed.
  • Includes a starter map generated from the current Brunch theme: 693 detected media slots across 43 theme and template groups.
  • Ships reviewed desktop and mobile homepage hero recipes; every other detected slot stays marked for review until its art direction is approved.
  • Keeps all media processing local and preserves the original files.
